name: prismic-community
description: Prismic's public AI plugins and skills for marketing, content, and website teams

plugins.name: geo-action-plan
plugins.description: Turn your AI visibility tool's data into a ranked plan of pages to create or update, and sites and threads to get mentioned in, so AI assistants cite you.

plugins.name: ai-visibility-prompts-generator
plugins.description: Generate the prompts to track in AI visibility tools such as Peec AI or Profound: a tagged, category-relevant buyer prompt library split equally across four buyer stages.

plugins.name: write-and-publish-optimized-articles
plugins.description: Write, SEO-optimize and publish articles end to end: research, interview, outline, draft, internal and external links, visuals, a fact-check of every claim, then an unpublished draft in your CMS (Prismic recommended).
